authority: Committed core events only. No animation callback grants materials, changes loaded parts, fires, targets or advances turns.

coordinates.normals: Original Cinderwall OpenGL +Y, linear, flip green in Unreal, strength 0.35
coordinates.attachments: FBX sockets retain armature unit scale; already-centimetre static payloads use absolute world scale 1.

unload.condition: Presentation was loaded; empty End Turn unload emits no false motion.

gun.interruptions: New legal actions replace short gun cosmetics without accumulating a queue. Claw playback remains independent.
gun.idle_limit: UE compression removes the source gun idle's sub-centimetre valve drift. Action clips must retain measured motion.

claw.resource_accounting: The exact haul is already committed. The scrap cluster is cosmetic, not a material count or second haul.

stage.scope: Dimensional apron, two side halls, six distant foundry masses/stacks/windows and rear hopper. Hide the earlier static claw when this rig is active.

restart: Return both rigs to idle; clear loaded presentation, payload/drop state and all shot effects.
quality: Early original hero implementation. Source/import success is not F.I.S.T.-level finish, human playtesting or owner approval.
